issues.title: Missing Concrete Examples for Multi-Format Output
issues.why: While AC-09 and 06-output-formatting.md define the requirement for CSV/Markdown/JSON, they lack the specific sample I/O or 'Worked Cases' required for a mediocre coder to implement the exact layout (e.g., specific CSV headers or Markdown table styles) without guessing.
issues.fix: Add a 'Worked Examples' section to 06-output-formatting.md with sample input data and the resulting CSV/JSON/MD strings.
